identitySignals: Aspire's Bay Area locations page lists 'Aspire Lionel Wilson College Preparatory Academy' (grades 6-12) as one of three Aspire schools in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda name exactly

The school's page on aspirepublicschools.org says it is a charter school operated by Aspire Public Schools, a K-12 nonprofit, and that it is sponsored by Oakland Unified School District, matching the OUSD Board Measures N and H agreement
Aspire Public Schools is a registered 501(c)(3) educational nonprofit in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-3311088), matching the operator named on the school page
research.notes: Contact details are for the Aspire Public Schools main office, not the school site (the school page lists 400 105th Ave, Oakland, CA 94603 and 510-635-7737). The homepage lists communications@aspirepublicschools.org while the contact page lists info@aspirepublicschools.org; the contact page was used. California Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked. A separate entity, Aspire Public Schools Foundation (EIN 84-2381617), also exists and was not used.

profile.summary: Aspire Public Schools is a nonprofit that runs public charter schools for kindergarten through 12th grade in California. It focuses on preparing students from underserved communities for college. Aspire Lionel Wilson College Preparatory Academy is one of its Oakland charter schools, serving grades 6 through 12.
